reading.text:
UNIT def:LevyStochCalc.Poisson.Compensated.TimeGrid
Standing setting (paper section 2, intro (eq:mvfbsdej), section 3 solution space, section 4,
appendix A): (Omega, F, (F_t), P) satisfying the usual conditions, horizon T > 0; a d-dim
Brownian motion W and an independent Poisson random measure N on R_+ x E with intensity
dt nu(de), nu sigma-finite on a countably generated (E, calE); (F_t) is the usual augmentation
of the filtration generated by W, N and an independent initial sigma-field F_0. The compensated
measure is Ntilde(dt,de) = N(dt,de) - dt nu(de). Integrands U of the Poisson integral are
predictable: P (x) calE-measurable, P the predictable sigma-field on Omega x [0,T]
(eq:fubiniiso), with E int_0^T ||U_t||^2_{L2(nu)} dt < infinity (the space H^2_N). The
integral int_0^t int_E U_s(e) Ntilde(ds,de) is the standard L2 (Ito-Levy) compensated-Poisson
integral: an L2 martingale, cadlag, with the isometry E|int_0^t int U dNtilde|^2 =
E int_0^t ||U_s||^2 ds (used in Lemma 4.1 "true L2-martingales by the Ito and
compensated-Poisson isometries"), jumps Delta = U_s(e) at atoms (s,e) of N, and for integrands
in L1(dP dt nu) the integral splits as int U dN - int U nu ds (eq:compid, eq:zeromean).
Progressive measurability is used for the coefficient processes b, sigma, f and the forcings
q^b, q^sigma, q^f (eq:coefmeas, section 4); predictability (P (x) calE) for h and q^h.

Reading.
The paper has no notion of a time grid: the compensated integral is the standard L2 integral,
constructed (in any standard reference) as the isometric extension of the elementary integral of
step integrands on finite partitions 0 = t_0 < t_1 < ... < t_N of the time axis. A "TimeGrid"
structure is an auxiliary of that construction. It is faithful if it encodes a finite partition
of the time axis (points starting at 0, nondecreasing or strictly increasing, finitely many) used
for left-open right-closed intervals (t_i, t_{i+1}]; any grid of this kind is admissible (the
construction must not depend on a particular grid for its final value). Its fields carry no
meaning of the paper beyond that; what matters is that the integral built on top
(stochasticIntegral) is the paper integral.

comparison.text:
Lean (LevyStochCalc/Poisson/MarkStepIsometry.lean): structure TimeGrid with N0 : N (number of
pieces), p : N -> R (grid points), p_zero : p 0 = 0, p_lt : for i < N0, p i < p (i+1); values of p
beyond N0 are irrelevant (eval and integral sum over i < N0). TimeGrid.dyadic T hT n
(MarkStepIncrement.lean): N0 = 2^n, p i = i T / 2^n (strictly increasing, p 0 = 0, horizon
p N0 = T). Comparison with the locked reading: a finite partition 0 = t_0 < ... < t_N of the time
axis, used for left-open right-closed pieces; strict monotonicity and t_0 = 0 are recorded as
structure fields (stronger than the reading required). No paper notion; auxiliary of the
construction, correct for its role.
Matches the reading.
